memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'Look! I am making everything new!'

sequence.prompt: How does the whole big story go? Put it in order.

items.label: God made everything, and it was good
People chose their own way and spoiled it

matches.prompt: Match each one to what the new world will be like.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: God wipes every one away Himself
Made new and mended, not thrown away
Standing wide open for every nation

application.question: God is making everything new. What are you most looking forward to?
application.followUp: The Bible begins with God making a world and walking with His people — and it ends in exactly the same place, except this world can never be spoiled and nobody has to leave. That is where the story has been going the whole time. God says: I make everything new!
